tool.series: JS554 Jabro-Solid2 universal, square, 4 flutes, cylindrical, 45 deg chamfer (inch)

material.vendor_label: P12 Maraging and precipitation-hardening stainless steels (500 < Rm < 1200 N/mm2; reference X 5 CrNiCuNb 16 4 = 17-4 PH, Rm 1100)

vendor_notes: SMG = Seco material group; vc in m/min (sf/min); fz in mm/tooth (in/tooth); ap and ae are factors of DC; coolant code A=air D=dry E=emulsion M=mist spray; 'All cutting data are target values'; 'For cutting data recalculations, see pages 561 - 568' (catalog printed page numbers)
rows.notes: Read from the Seco Solid End Mills catalog 2023.2 (PDF page 95; printed page number is 2 lower). Each SMG has a metric line and an italic inch line; the numeric inch values (in/tooth, sf/min) are the printed italic line, the metric line is kept in cells. ap = ap/DC x DC = 1 x 0.25000 in = 0.2500 in; ae = 0.4 x DC = 0.1000 in. Tool: 5540250Z4.0-SIRON-A (item 02711329), the catalog part at this diameter whose APMXS covers the published ap. SMG P12 is named 'Maraging and precipitation-hardening stainless steels' with reference X5CrNiCuNb16-4 (17-4 PH, 1.4542), so mapped to 17-4 PH; the SMG spans conditions of 500-1200 N/mm2 and the single printed value applies to the whole group. Vendor values are 'target values'; one vc/fz pair per SMG and diameter, SFM min/max are the printed range around the printed value. Checked against rendered PDF page 95 (110 dpi image): column-to-diameter mapping, SMG row, metric/inch lines and vc range confirmed. No neck relief at this part (DN not below DC or not published); neck_diameter and LB left null.

vendor_notes: SMG = Seco material group; vc in m/min (sf/min); fz in mm/tooth (in/tooth); ap and ae are factors of DC; coolant code A=air D=dry E=emulsion M=mist spray; 'All cutting data are target values'; 'For cutting data recalculations, see pages 561 - 568' (catalog printed page numbers)
rows.notes: Read from the Seco Solid End Mills catalog 2023.2 (PDF page 403; printed page number is 2 lower). Each SMG has a metric line and an italic inch line; the numeric inch values (in/tooth, sf/min) are the printed italic line, the metric line is kept in cells. ap = ap/DC x DC = 0.46 x 0.05906 in = 0.0027 in; ae = 0.05 x DC = 0.0030 in. Tool: JME142015G5R005Z2.0-HXT (item 03205165), the catalog part at this diameter whose APMXS covers the published ap. SMG H8 'Tool steels / HSS' covers 38-64 HRC (reference X40CrMoV5-1 = H13 at 50 HRC); the single vendor value spans the whole 38-64 HRC range, so it is not specific to 45-50 HRC. Vendor values are 'target values'; one vc/fz pair per SMG and diameter, SFM min/max are the printed range around the printed value. Checked against rendered PDF page 403 (110 dpi image): column-to-diameter mapping, SMG row, metric/inch lines and vc range confirmed. Neck geometry: neck_diameter = catalog DN, LB = catalog LN (neck/reach length).  Only length indices 5 and 6 exist at 1.5 mm in the catalog; LV5 tool has LN 22.5 mm and DN 1.45 mm. Table is the LV1 base; recalculated per the vendor LV5 row. The resulting ap is very small (vendor figure).
